portfolio.title: Cool Roof Reflective Coating in High-Density Receptors
portfolio.prerequisite_verification_note: Suitable based on current ward vulnerability screening criteria.
directional_effects: Indoor thermal comfort in uninsulated tin/asbestos housing
portfolio.scientific_rationale: High-albedo solar-reflective coating reduces treated roof surface temperatures by 2-3°C, moderating ward-level heat proxy.
portfolio.cost_provenance: Market rate estimate for elastomeric high-albedo coatings; assumes municipal or community permission.
portfolio.benefit_provenance: Well-established surface physics; macro-ward heat effect depends on treated roof area fraction.
portfolio.rationale: Selected 3 building cluster by MILP optimizer. Targets heat_exposure_proxy (Ward score: 58.4/100) with unit utility 68.4 pts under equity factor 1.0x.
portfolio.selection_justification: Allocated under budget ceiling INR 5,000,000. Contributes 205.3 prioritization utility points.

assumptions_and_limitations: Objective values represent estimated prioritization utility, NOT validated reductions in physical disaster damage.
Costs are municipal engineering heuristics and exclude land acquisition, inflation, or specialized subcontractor markups.
Workforce demand estimates assume standard municipal crew productivity without factoring weather or monsoon work stoppages.
Site suitability checks reflect OpenCity and PMC spatial datasets; localized ground-truth site surveys remain mandatory prior to procurement.
